assessment.subject: Accepted source-delta boundary
assessment.evidence: derive_inputs.py:40-69 hashes the accepted repair report/review, verifies review decision and repair binding, rehashes repair inputs, loads the old accepted manifest, and requires exact prior hashes for changed entries. The final three-path set and count forbid extra, missing or duplicate deltas. All other source entries and consumer hashes must remain unchanged. Hash-bound refresh output matched recomputation exactly.

assessment.subject: Metadata and identity preservation
assessment.evidence: derive_inputs.py:79-100 requires two equal seven-row observations, explicit completeness/equality booleans and the old CLI hash. In old-baseline order it requires matching names, IDs, images, running state, no restart policy, exact integer restart counts, foundation digest and configured metadata. Existing network projection validates allowed bindings. Startup and attachment observations are recomputed, with differences recorded; current identity or foundation drift is not silently accepted. Raw capture rows need no attempt field, as explicitly covered by the synthetic regression.

assessment.subject: Commands, options, policies and model boundary
assessment.evidence: Applications and manifest are deep copies of hash-pinned prior inputs; only source hashes and the explicitly listed top-level proposal fields change. Commands, create options, network aliases, policies, network bindings and replacement configured hashes remain unchanged. Four hash-pinned historical models pass existing final_model/project helpers and must reproduce the existing configured replacement digests. Models are predictions, not newly observed identities or attachment/health proof. No new IDs or images are issued.

assessment.subject: No reservation or approval escalation
assessment.evidence: derive_inputs.py:74-78 only checks marker existence: both prior V6e markers must remain present, either consumed V6f marker refuses derivation. No marker is created or removed. Derivation returns a proposed candidate with decision INCOMPLETE and empty reviewer, plus authorization booleans false. Existing Plan.load refuses that unaccepted candidate, as tested. source_refresh.json deliberately uses companion-source-refresh-only-v1, not a preparation-manifest schema.

limitations: Actual baseline remains MISSING. Byte equality, completeness flags, a supplied hash and an observed_end_utc field do not independently prove freshness or acquisition provenance. Any future real observation must receive its own bounded input review.
Marker checks are not an atomic reservation and do not authorize preparation; downstream reservation/identity guards remain necessary. No marker contents or credentials were read by this review.
The implementation has no capture or publication entrypoint. Its returned proof state READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW does not convert the candidate decision INCOMPLETE into acceptance.

No native CLI, Docker, token, DB, HTTP, service, capture or runtime operation performed. No real new candidate generated or published. Only this review artifact written; no source, tests, other docs or shared worklog edited.
